Trajectory Labs, PBC

Builds tests that look for harmful AI behavior. It also creates practice tasks for AI training.

What Trajectory Labs, PBC sells

  • Safety evaluations and red teaming: Experts design new attacks to test weaknesses in advanced agents and their cybersecurity safeguards.
  • Safety RL environments: Tasks and attack examples reveal failures and help train safer behavior.
  • Search-PI Complex: A benchmark developed with Meta for prompt injection (malicious instructions that try to redirect an AI). Uses a fixed set of attacks generated by Trajectory Labs’ proprietary attacker.
